docker.update_command:
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
ctr_updater_file="$(mktemp)"
trap '"'"'rm -f -- "$ctr_updater_file"'"'"' EXIT
curl --proto =https --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NoobCity99/CTRoadmap/2ea382b5f1ea982c6c7ed6b90d9b4f8acce30d0e/ctr_update.sh -o "$ctr_updater_file"
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' 015ba16f3c42d114da94f9f6b4b5b855f69d9117a893c030871f25cf6b909a75 "$ctr_updater_file" | sha256sum --check --status
chmod +x "$ctr_updater_file"
bash "$ctr_updater_file"'
docker.notes: In v0.10.2-beta, open Settings > Preferences > Language to try Spanish or Italian. Labels awaiting translation appear in English. Rack Builder adds 17 connector types and 13 cable types. You can mark HDMI and DisplayPort ports as audio-capable, trace audio connections in the Handbook, and see a warning when a cable and port have different connector faces. On Rack elevations and exported PNGs, equipment names appear in callouts when a faceplate or nearby hardware would obscure them. Standard Linux installations continue to use Host Updater 0.2.0 and Snapshot Tools 0.1.1. NAS and Portainer installations use their platform's native update workflow.
summary: Spanish and Italian language previews in Settings
17 new Rack connector types and 13 new cable types
Audio wiring in the Connect Table, cable traces and Handbook
Clearer equipment labels in Rack elevations and PNG exports
